Subject: Intro phone screen — Micah O'Brien (flexible slots)

Hi Micah,

Thanks for applying to Redwood Inference — I’m Priyom on the recruiting team. We’d love to schedule a quick 20‑minute phone screen to chat about your background and the Open Inference Platform role. I pulled a few windows that should work on our side (all in PDT):

- Tue Jun 15, 09:30–09:50 PDT
- Tue Jun 15, 13:00–13:20 PDT
- Wed Jun 16, 08:45–09:05 PDT

If any of those line up, reply with the one that works for you and confirm the timezone you’re in (I saw you’re in the UK from your resume — I want to make sure I don’t miss DST). If those don’t work, give me 2–3 windows next week and I’ll match.

Also attaching your resume we received (micah_resume.pdf) for quick reference. I can send an ICS once we lock a time — we use a 20m template but can extend to 30m if the hiring manager prefers.

Thanks — look forward to connecting.

Best,
Priyom Das

My availability next week in BST:
- Tue Jun 15: 14:30–17:30 BST
- Wed Jun 16: 10:00–12:00 BST and 16:00–17:30 BST

If you can convert your Tue/Wed suggestions to BST and resend options I can accept, that’d be great. I’m happy with either 20m or 30m — 30m is better if you think we’ll cover specifics.

Cheers,
Micah O'Brien
micah.obrien@gmail.com | +44 7700 900123
